item.title: All Permissions Granted: Agentic AI, Delegated Access, and the Governance of Semantic Footprints
item.description: This review examines how agentic AI reorganizes privacy, accountability and user agency by turning delegated access into operational context. item.title: MetaNav: Metacognitive Vision-Language Navigation via Reflective Exploration
item.description: Training-free Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) agents powered by foundation models can follow instructions and explore 3D environments. However, existing approaches rely on greedy frontier selection and passive spatial memory, leading to inefficient behaviors such as local oscillation and redundant revisiting. item.description: Accurate mango leaf disease recognition is important for automated crop-health assessment, but reliable evaluation requires transparent data partitioning, appropriate baseline comparison, and cautious interpretation of severity and explainability outputs. item.description: Recent research has established that generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is not a unitary workplace resource: exploratory and exploitative use orientations are associated with different forms of employee creativity, and their value depends on employees' capacity to integrate generated knowledge. item.description: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLM) has created new possibilities for automating software development, yet ensuring the quality of AI-generated code remains a major challenge.
